lower_initialization: Identical COMBAT30 round203 weights in all arms; fresh lower Adam, no warmup.
execution: Sequential four-rank trials using the existing launcher. B starts after A has at least 30 complete rounds and a verified boundary save. C starts after B completes 30 rounds or fails qualification; never overlap trial collectors. Every trial is finite; the selected long training remains continuous without a total-round limit.

comparison.primary: Compare complete-cohort win rate and floor progression at equal cumulative training wall time, using only fully finished rounds within the common time budget.
comparison.secondary: Compare identical first 30 cohorts (28800 starting games), last 10 rounds and their two non-overlapping 5-round windows; report exclusions, actual upper samples, optimizer steps and KL.
comparison.practical_gate: Prefer B over A only with consistent improvement across both final windows: at least +0.5 percentage points win rate or +2 floors with no material win regression, and no regression at the common training-time budget. C must clear the same comparison against B, not just run faster or fit a lower training loss.
comparison.inconclusive: Do not claim a winner from a rare-win fluctuation. Preserve all arms, diagnose optimization or representation and plan a separately bounded follow-up. Thirty rounds screen early learning, not final ceiling.
comparison.capacity_interpretation: B versus C changes width, depth and latent count together as a capacity package; it does not isolate width alone. A versus B preserves exact initial weights and changes only actor learning rate.
comparison.limitations: Single training replica per arm; matching game seeds does not imply matching future actions or RNG consumption. Historical COMBAT30 has a different lower initialization and is descriptive context, not the causal control.

post_screen.decision: C did not clear the preregistered benefit gate; B resumes from full round30 state. This is an operating choice, not proof of long-run capacity inferiority.
post_screen.reference: Preserve immutable trial30 full bundle before rolling recovery retention can remove it.

conditional_followup.trigger: At or after round60, inspect three successive non-overlapping 10-round windows. If both adjacent windows improve average floor by less than 0.5 and win rate by less than 0.5 percentage points, or there is sustained regression, investigate data/optimization before launching this experiment. Do not trigger on a single bad cohort.
conditional_followup.hypothesis: Low realized actor KL and the A/B learning-rate response justify testing update magnitude before another capacity increase.
conditional_followup.initialization: Both arms fork the same verified full checkpoint including upper/lower Adam, learner RNG, all 240 environments per rank and cohort counters; preserve native/source/reward/search and critic LR.
conditional_followup.execution: Sequential four-rank paired continuation, separate run identities; do not compare candidate with an unrelated historical segment.
conditional_followup.comparison: Common completed-round wall budget and equal19200 starting games, last two5-round windows; same +0.5pp win or +2floor practical gate with no material win/common-time regression. A single training replica remains exploratory.
